product_updates.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
product_updates.content: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

product_updates.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
product_updates.content: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

product_updates.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
product_updates.content: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
